annotations.summary: Docker restart counter climbing for a container on ovh-prod
annotations.description: container.restarts is a cumulative counter from the docker_stats receiver; an increase inside the window means dockerd is restarting the container. Also the only way to see an unhealthy container flip: a failing healthcheck under restart: unless-stopped shows up here as repeated increments, and container.uptime resets alongside it. DISABLED BY DEFAULT: the prod collector currently has receivers: [otlp] only, so this metric does not exist yet. Add the docker_stats receiver (snippet in README-alerts.md), then set signoz_alert_enable_docker_stats: true.
